page_intro: Run Lightning Address discovery one step at a time and inspect every intermediate value.
page_meta_description: Inspect Lightning Address discovery for NIP-57 zaps
address_split_outro: without normalizing or silently correcting the input.
endpoint_resolved: Endpoint resolved without an HTTP request
endpoint_prerequisite: Complete Step 1 and explicitly resolve the endpoint.
fetch_response_prerequisite: Review the resolved URL in Step 2, then explicitly run the GET request.
recipient_notice_intro: Recipient pubkey identifies the person receiving the zap. It is separate from the LNURL provider
parameters_prerequisite: Step 4 requires a valid LUD-06 response, supported NIP-57 advertisement, callback, amount range, and LNURL-pay URL.
build_request_prerequisite: Validate Step 4, then explicitly build the Zap Request.
signing_error_notice: {error}. The unsigned event is preserved; you can retry.
sign_request_prerequisite: Build and validate an unsigned event in Step 5 first.
callback_prerequisite: Sign the Zap Request in Step 6 first. The callback is only requested when you explicitly continue.
invoice_amount_mismatch: Invoice amount does not match requested amount
inspect_amount_prerequisite: Get a Lightning invoice from the callback in Step 7 first.
sent_zap_request_json: Zap Request JSON actually sent in Step 7
direct_description_warning: This invoice contains a direct description (d) instead of a description hash (h). It is not a NIP-57 Zap invoice, so a Zap Receipt is not expected.
field_calculated_description_hash: SHA-256 of the sent Zap Request JSON
description_hash_match: Invoice description hash matches Zap Request
description_hash_mismatch: Invoice description hash does not match Zap Request
verify_hash_prerequisite: Decode the Lightning invoice in Step 8 first.
regular_invoice_payment_warning: This is a regular Lightning invoice, not a NIP-57 Zap invoice. Payment may succeed, but a Zap Receipt is not expected.
regular_invoice_payment_instruction: Pay this invoice with your Lightning wallet.
zap_invoice_payment_instruction: Pay this invoice with your Lightning wallet, then continue to the next step.
after_zap_payment: After paying the invoice, continue by waiting for the Zap Receipt.
payment_prerequisite: Payment handoff requires a matching invoice amount and either a matching description hash or a direct description confirmed in Step 9.
receipt_subscription_notice: This step discovers unverified candidates. It does not validate Zap Receipt IDs, signatures, authors, or tags.
no_receipt_candidates: No candidate Zap Receipt received yet
wait_receipt_prerequisite: Step 11 requires a matching invoice amount and Zap Request description hash, a signed Zap Request, recipient p tag, and at least one relay from its relays tag.
receipt_validation_notice: Validation starts only when requested. Candidate IDs are not trusted: each event ID and signature are independently verified.
field_expected_description: Exact Zap Request JSON sent to callback
validate_receipt_prerequisite: Step 12 requires at least one Step 11 candidate and the validated LNURL provider nostrPubkey.
qr_invoice_alt: QR code for opening this invoice in a Lightning wallet
qr_failure_instruction: {error}. Use Copy invoice or Open wallet instead.
diagnostic_address_one_at: Lightning Address must contain exactly one @.
diagnostic_address_username_required: Username is required. The optional @domain shorthand is not supported.
diagnostic_address_username_characters: Username may contain only lowercase a-z, 0-9, -, _, ., and + for tags.
diagnostic_address_domain_structure: Domain must be a valid hostname without a scheme, port, path, or credentials.
diagnostic_address_domain_invalid: Domain must be a valid hostname.
diagnostic_lud06_min_integer: minSendable is a safe integer number
diagnostic_lud06_max_integer: maxSendable is a safe integer number
diagnostic_lud06_metadata_entries: every metadata entry is an array beginning with a type string
diagnostic_lud06_plain_count: metadata contains exactly one text/plain entry
diagnostic_lud06_long_string: text/long-desc values are strings when present
diagnostic_lud06_image_count: image metadata uses at most one PNG or JPEG entry
diagnostic_nip57_pubkey_valid: nostrPubkey is a valid BIP-340 public key
diagnostic_nip57_pubkey_invalid: nostrPubkey is not a valid BIP-340 public key
diagnostic_parameters_amount_integer: amount is a decimal integer millisatoshi value
diagnostic_parameters_relay_scheme: every relay URL uses ws: or wss:
diagnostic_request_p_recipient: p tag contains recipient hex pubkey
diagnostic_request_relays_present: relays tag has at least one relay
diagnostic_request_lnurl_match: lnurl tag equals encoded LNURL-pay URL
diagnostic_request_e_absent: no e tag for this person zap
diagnostic_request_created_at: created_at is an integer Unix timestamp
diagnostic_key_encoding: input is lowercase 64-character hex or a valid npub
diagnostic_key_decoded: recipient pubkey decoded to 32-byte lowercase hex
diagnostic_key_curve: recipient pubkey is a valid BIP-340 x-only public key
diagnostic_bolt11_short: BOLT11 data part is too short
diagnostic_bolt11_boundary: BOLT11 tagged field exceeds the data boundary
diagnostic_bolt11_amount_integer: Invoice amount must be a positive decimal integer without leading zeros
diagnostic_bolt11_pico: Pico-bitcoin amount does not represent an integer millisatoshi
diagnostic_bolt11_both_descriptions: Invoice contains both a direct description and a description hash
diagnostic_bolt11_direct_description: Invoice contains a direct description instead of a description hash
diagnostic_bolt11_no_description: Invoice contains neither a direct description nor a description hash
diagnostic_bolt11_description_length: Invoice description hash has an invalid length
diagnostic_bolt11_description_bits: Invoice description hash is not 256 bits
diagnostic_receipt_event_id: Calculated event ID matches claimed event ID
diagnostic_receipt_serialize: Event fields cannot be serialized safely
diagnostic_receipt_signature: BIP-340 Schnorr signature over calculated event ID
diagnostic_receipt_recipient: Recipient p tag matches Zap Request
diagnostic_receipt_sender_match: Optional sender P tag matches Zap Request pubkey
diagnostic_receipt_e_tag: Applicable e tag copied from Zap Request
diagnostic_receipt_a_tag: Applicable a tag copied from Zap Request
diagnostic_receipt_invoice: BOLT11 tag contains current callback invoice
diagnostic_receipt_description: Description exactly matches Zap Request JSON sent to callback
diagnostic_receipt_author: Receipt author matches LNURL provider nostrPubkey
diagnostic_receipt_amount: Receipt invoice amount matches Zap Request amount
diagnostic_receipt_amount_missing: Zap Request has no amount tag
diagnostic_receipt_amount_match: Amount in receipt bolt11 matches Zap Request amount
diagnostic_receipt_lnurl: Zap Request lnurl matches current recipient LNURL
diagnostic_receipt_lnurl_missing: Zap Request has no lnurl tag
diagnostic_receipt_lnurl_recommended: Zap Request lnurl SHOULD match current recipient LNURL
diagnostic_receipt_hash: SHA256(receipt description) matches invoice h field
diagnostic_receipt_hash_recommended: SHA256(receipt description) SHOULD match invoice h field
diagnostic_receipt_preimage: Optional preimage matches BOLT11 payment hash

diagnostic_error_callback_pr: The JSON response does not contain a string pr.
diagnostic_error_http_json: Response body is not valid JSON.
diagnostic_image_limit: image metadata values are at most {imageCharacterLimit} characters
diagnostic_invoice_amounts: Receipt invoice: {invoiceAmount} msat · Zap Request: {requestAmount} msat
